name: skill-quality-gate
instructions:
Run a reproducible, composable Skill-bundle quality gate with policy-as-code severities, baseline deltas, security and agentic evaluations, mutation/property/adversarial checks, SARIF/attestations, and fail-closed verdicts.

Capabilities:
- define and execute dependency-aware quality gates within explicit skill-dev scope
- evaluate structural, behavioral, security, agentic, reproducibility, and artifact integrity properties
- compare immutable baselines and emit evidence-backed release decisions

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/skill-dev/skill-quality-gate/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Every required gate is terminal or explicitly BLOCKED/NOT-RUN; policy, baseline, replay, artifact integrity, evidence ledger, SARIF, and attestation checks are complete; verdict is fail-closed.
